Marissa —

Thanks for taking this. We started Greenleaf's supplier enrollment in Ariba this morning and ran into a couple of blocking items while attaching your MSA. I attached our suggested redline (Greenleaf_MSA_redline_v3.docx) — the portal team flagged two items that will block activation if we can't align:

- PO number prefix: our systems require a vendor-specific PO prefix (we use GLF-). Can your order form/portal mapping accept an external prefix?
- Tax ID format: Ariba requires a normalized Tax ID field (EIN without dashes). Current MSA references a "Tax ID (format TBD)" which Procurement needs clarified.

Also, the portal needs a confirmed signer name and authority for e-signature routing. Can you confirm your signer and whether DocuSign is acceptable?

We're also happy to upload KYC evidence to your intake checklist — I can attach corporate doc PDFs once we confirm the mapping fields.

Appreciate a quick call or answers in-thread so we can finish provisioning.

Best,
Alyssa Turner
Senior Procurement Manager
Greenleaf Medical
